close_reason: uuid_id.to_string() is test-backend only; minor allocation acceptable.
description: tests/common/mod.rs line ~498-502: Id::from(uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string()) creates an Id, then .to_string() is called again on uuid_id to produce a Value::String. This means the UUID string is allocated twice. The serde_json::Value::String should be built directly from the Uuid's string representation before the Id wraps it, or the Id's AsRef<str> impl should be used: Value::String(uuid_id.as_ref().to_owned()). Minor but representative of an allocation smell.
title: uuid_id created then immediately .to_string() to re-wrap
